description: Searches the contents of the packet's files for a JavaScript regular expression and returns each matching line as `path:line: text`. Paths are relative to the packet root; nothing outside the packet is reachable.

glob.description: Only search files whose path matches this glob, such as `tree/**/*.ts`.

path.description: Only search this file or directory, such as `tree/src`.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression, such as `parseRouting\(`.

name: grep

description: Lists the packet's file paths that match a glob: `**` is any number of directories, `*` any characters but `/`, `{a,b}` either. Paths are relative to the packet root; nothing outside the packet is reachable.

glob.description: The glob, such as `tree/**/*.md`; `**` lists every file.

name: list

description: Looks a top-level symbol up in `tree/REPO-MAP.md` and returns where each match is defined, as `tree/<path>:<line>`, with its kind, signature and reference count.

name.description: The symbol name; an exact match first, else every name containing it, ignoring case.

name: symbol
